summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Lone Peak SMID Value ETF (LPSV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The investment objective of the Lone Peak SMID Value ETF (the Fund) is to provide long-term capital appreciation. LPSV was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by Lone Peak.

holdings.infoBox: LPSV is an equity ETF with a total of 26 individual holdings. The top holdings are Sanmina stock at 6.99%, Photronics at 5.91%, Everus Construction Group at 5.89%, IES Holdings at 5.78%, and Global Payments at 4.88%.
